newsitem.title: UK: Rain seen in England on Sunday, Monday but dry now.
newsitem.headline: Rain seen in England on Sunday, Monday but dry now.

text.p: Rain is likely to return to England on Sunday and Monday, after a bright, dry end to this week.
"Monday's looking like the worst day of the weekend," a Meteorological Office spokesman, with the holiday in mind, said.
Rain may be bad news for Britons hoping to enjoy the national holiday on Monday outdoors, but it will cheer farmers and a water industry still desperate for all the moisture they can get.

Friday is dry, warm and sunny. There has been no rain reported in England in the last 24 hours, a spokesman for the London weather centre said. "At the moment it's hardly likely to rain for the next 24 hours," he said. "Then showery outbreaks will be coming in from the south-west. From Sunday, "overall low pressure in England and Wales means a lot of cloud and rain in places," he said.
